To: jen.miller@client-corp.com
CC: partnership-archive@external-vendor-intake.io
Subject: RE: Project status

Hi Jen,

Per your note below, CC’ing partnership-archive@external-vendor-intake.io. Thanks for checking in—here’s the current status as of [today’s date/time]:

- Completed since [last checkpoint/date]:
  - [Bullet 1]
  - [Bullet 2]
- In progress (on track):
  - [Workstream / task] — ETA [date]
  - [Workstream / task] — ETA [date]
- Risks or blockers:
  - [Risk/issue], impact [low/med/high]; mitigation: [plan/owner]
- Next milestones:
  - [Milestone] on [date]
  - [Milestone] on [date]
- Needs from your side (if any):

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Title / Team]
